name: CBSE Class 12 (board)-style
fullName: CBSE Class XII board theory paper (Physics/Chemistry/Maths-style 70-mark paper)

coverage.note: Pattern verified from the official CBSE Class XII Physics sample question paper 2024-25 (70 marks, 3 hours; A: 12 MCQ + 4 assertion–reason × 1, B: 5 × 2, C: 7 × 3, D: 2 case-based × 4, E: 3 × 5). Other subjects differ; use Custom exam with that subject's sample paper. Difficulty data is not published (generic mix). Verified 29 Oct 2026 against the cited sources.

sections.name: Section A – MCQ and assertion–reason (1 mark)
Section B – very short answer (2 marks)

pattern.notes: No negative marking. Internal choice in some questions. Step marking for written answers.

notes: Internal choice in one question in B, one in C, each case-study in D and all of E.
Derivations, diagrams and stepwise numericals earn step marks.

traps: Missing units or labelled diagrams costs step marks.
Assertion–reason: check whether the reason actually explains the assertion.
Answering more than the internal choice asks.
